segments.name: Consumer Banking
products: debit and credit card loan and fee businesses
segments.description: Serves individuals within the footprint through the Bank with deposits, digital banking, consumer lending, home equity lines, credit cards and residential mortgages.
segments.evidence: The Consumer Banking operating segment is designed to serve the holistic financial service needs of individuals within our footprint through the Bank.

segments.name: Commercial Banking
products: merchant and commercial bank card products
segments.description: Provides full-service relationship banking to businesses, agencies and community organizations, including commercial lending, treasury management, cash management and card payment solutions.
segments.evidence: The Commercial Banking operating segment is designed to provide full-service relationship banking solutions to businesses, agencies and community organizations within our footprint through the Bank.

segments.name: Wealth Management
products: financial, estate, and tax planning services
segments.description: Provides fee-only wealth management to individuals, businesses and foundations, including investment management, fiduciary, planning and retirement plan services.
segments.evidence: The Wealth Management operating segment provides a full range of "fee-only" wealth management solutions, including investment management, fiduciary services, financial, estate, and tax planning services to individuals, businesses, and foundations.

revenueModel.text: Businesses, individuals, agencies and community organizations pay the Bank for deposit, lending, card, treasury and wealth management services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our business model is designed to serve the holistic financial services needs of businesses, individuals, agencies and community organizations within our footprint.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company moved from two operating segments, Community Banking and Wealth Management, to three segments: Consumer, Commercial, and Wealth Management.
changes.evidence: Previously, the Company reported two operating segments: Community Banking and Wealth Management.
